sloka: संच्छिन्न बाहोः सद्यो वै बाहवः सहसा अभवन् ।विष ज्वालावली युक्ता वल्मीकत् इव पन्नगाः ॥३-५१-३९॥
transliteration: saṁcchinna bāhoḥ sadyo vai bāhavaḥ sahasā abhavan ।viṣa jvālāvalī yuktā valmīkat iva pannagāḥ ॥3-51-39॥

translations.english: As the left arms were cut off, there came out from them all the ten arms instantaneously like serpents emitting poisonous flames from anthills
